FULL TEXT:
PRESS RELEASE
District Child Protection Unit, Kancheepuram
Applications Invited for Temporary Vacancies in Kancheepuram District Juvenile Justice Board
Applications are invited from eligible candidates to fill the following newly created posts in the Juvenile Justice
Board functioning in Kancheepuram District purely on a temporary and consolidated pay basis:
Sl.
No. Designation Qualification No. of
Vacancies Remuneration
1 Junior Assistant-
cum-Record Clerk
Pass in (X) 10th Standard or its equivalent
(Preference will be given to candidates who
have typing certificate (Tamil & English) and
proficiency in computer)
1 Rs. 20,000/- per
month
2 Office Assistant Pass in (VIII) 8thStandard or its equivalent 1 Rs. 13,000/- per
month
Important Details:
 These positions are purely temporary and on a consolidated remuneration basis.
 Candidates cannot claim permanent absorption in service under any circumstances.
 Candidates must be aged between 18 and 42 years.
 Selection Process: Candidates will be selected by the District Selection Committee in accordance with
the 'Mission Vatsalya' guidelines.
 Educational Qualification: Educational qualifications defined under the Madras High Court Service
Rules, 2015, shall apply.
 How to Apply: Eligible candidates must submit their application along with their resume and copies of
relevant educational and experience certificates.
 Address for Submitting
Applications:
District Child Protection Officer,
District Child Protection Unit,
No. 317, K.T.S. Mani Street (Near Mamallan Metric School),
Kancheepuram District – 631502.
Contact No: 6382613096
Duly filled-in applications should reach the above office either in person or by post within 15 days from the date
of publication of this notice. For further details, please visit the official website of Kancheepuram District
(kancheepuram.nic.in).
District Collector / Chair Person,
District Child Protection Unit,
Kancheepuram District.
